acceptance.artifact: holdout transcripts per generation plus a comparison table
acceptance.assertion: G0, G1 and G2 are each scored on the frozen holdout with the same command and the same inputs, transcripts recorded, and the generation identity is withheld from the scorer where the interface permits. Any generation that cannot be scored is reported NOT_SUPPORTED with the exact boundary rather than omitted or given a default.
acceptance.falsified_if: generations are scored by different paths or a failure to score is silently omitted

hypothesis: All three generations can be scored on the holdout using identical inputs and a single scoring path, so the numbers are comparable rather than three separate claims.
